mapper.sql: d.uuid, d.external_id, d.organization_uuid, d.workspace_uuid, d.name, d.description, d.created_at, d.updated_at, v.uuid AS version_uuid, v.external_id AS version_external_id, v.version AS version, CAST(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_cases c WHERE c.version_uuid = v.uuid AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS integer) AS case_count

uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, dataset_uuid, version_uuid, position, query, expected_answer, expected_tool_trace, source_session_id, polarity, acceptance, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_datasets ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, name, description, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Description}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING uuid, external_id

INSERT INTO evaluation_dataset_versions ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, dataset_uuid, version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.DatasetUUID}, #{params.Version}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, dataset_uuid, version, created_at

INSERT INTO evaluation_cases ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, dataset_uuid, version_uuid, position, query, expected_answer, expected_tool_trace, source_session_id, polarity, acceptance, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.DatasetUUID}, #{params.VersionUUID}, #{params.Position}, #{params.Query}, #{params.ExpectedAnswer}, CAST(#{params.ExpectedToolTrace} AS jsonb), #{params.SourceSessionID}, #{params.Polarity}, #{params.Acceptance}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, dataset_uuid, version, created_at FROM evaluation_dataset_versions WHERE dataset_uuid = #{datasetUUID} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
